source_observations.observation: Outer default through the last pre-vati rule. The pinned numbering of the excluded vati endpoint is 115.

source_observations.locator: Patañjali, Mahābhāṣya at 5.1.20, vārttika on aluki
source_observations.observation: The two-basket and three-basket contrasted with buying using those already qualified items. Also supplies a third-person practitioner example outside the inner default.
Hundred used as price versus the hundred as the measure of the collection. The object may independently be a hundred garments.
Confirms that an incidental hundred does not suppress the alternatives. Digitized garment wording differs from the pinned Kāśikā; no new garment lemma taken from it.
Count as ordinary number and as technical designation, with two ṭhañ controls.
Records the neuter katikam and the objection and answer on inferring affix meaning by positive and negative comparison.
The optional augment belongs to kan. Vatu supplies technical numeral status and a prior, distinct measure affix.
Names retain kan. Nyāsa restricts the need for rule division specifically to thirty, and discusses two vowel-resolution accounts for twenty.
Explicit non-name thirty-price example under general ṭi loss before a ḍit suffix.
Both retention and luk after two or three niṣkas with a single purchase. This limits what can be inferred from the long form.
